title: VALUES returning one row and one column can be used as a scalar
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), Product[Product] = "Lock" ) )

source.quote: DAX tries to convert the table to a scalar value, and it fails if there are multiple rows.
source.supports: a one-row, one-column table converts to its value

source.quote: An equivalent expression for SELECTEDVALUE(<columnName>, <alternateResult>) is IF(HASONEVALUE(<columnName>), VALUES(<columnName>), <alternateResult>) .
source.supports: SELECTEDVALUE returns the value when the column has one visible value, else the alternate

derivation: Only Lock is visible, so VALUES ( Product[Color] ) has the single row Blue, which converts to the scalar "Blue".
